observations: Photo 0 shows a flat-screen TV mounted on a wall above a light pink TV stand with decorative items.
The TV screen is off and reflects window blinds and part of the room.
The brand logo at the bottom center of the TV is visible but too small to read clearly.
The TV is not in a carton; it is installed in a living room setting.
No remote control or accessories are visible in the photo.
The seller claims the TV is faulty, still in the carton, and working — none of which are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: The brand logo is visible at the bottom center of the TV in photo 0 but is too small to read clearly. No text or label confirms 'Hisense'.
The screen is off and reflects the room; no visible damage or fault is apparent. No proof of screen malfunction is shown.

claims.claim: Still in the carton with remote control etc.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the TV mounted on the wall in a living room, not in a carton. No remote or accessories are visible.
The TV is off; no power indicator or screen activity is visible. No proof of functionality is shown.

risks.risk: The TV may not be a Hisense or may not be 49 inches.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the TV bezel or back panel showing the brand and model label.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown brand and size, which may be significantly cheaper.

risks.risk: The screen is faulty as claimed, but the fault is not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the screen defect (e.g., dead pixels, lines, color issues) or a test of the screen in use.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a non-working TV, since the fault is unproven but claimed.

risks.risk: The TV is not in the carton and accessories are missing, contradicting the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV in its original carton with all accessories (remote, cables, manuals) included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a used TV without accessories, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The TV is not working, despite the seller’s claim.
risks.proof: Video or photo of the TV powered on, displaying an image or test pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, which drastically reduces value.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the TV bezel or back panel showing the brand and model.
Video or photo of the TV powered on, showing screen functionality.
Photo of the TV in its original carton with all accessories (remote, cables, manuals).
Photo or video showing the screen defect if faulty.
response.reason: The TV’s brand, size, condition, and accessories cannot be verified from the single photo. The seller’s claims are contradicted or unverified, and critical risks (faulty screen, not working, not in carton) require proof before pricing. Without proof, the item cannot be priced accurately.
